execution: physical SIM via PC/SC and a USB smart-card reader
summary: The physical SIM supported P-256 elliptic-curve cryptography and signed with ECDSA.
signature_path: ASN.1 DER ECDSA over SHA-256, converted to P1363 and verified on the host
key_storage: the private key is generated on the card and does not leave it
scope: Signing-capability capture. PC/SC does not attest the applet build, signature bytes or card identity.
